event.title: docs(specs): island server rendering capability
event.author: predictable-code[bot]
event.body:
## Why

The server side of the island runtime — src/runtime/server.ts (renderIsland, renderStatic, renderToString, renderToStaticMarkup) and src/runtime/islands.ts (registryOf, revive, Slot, ISLAND_TAG, SLOT_TAG), which scripts/render/core.mjs and scripts/lib/pieces-harness.mjs use to pre-render every piece — was documented by no capability: 'predictable specs undocumented' listed its exports among 134 exported functions no capability documents, and no test called renderIsland, revive or registryOf directly (src/islands.test.tsx renders stories with preact-render-to-string, not through this runtime).

## What changed

- New capability SPEC-403 'Island server rendering', covering src/runtime/server.ts and src/runtime/islands.ts. Its description states only what the code does, checked against it: registryOf keeps capitalised component exports; renderIsland throws for an unregistered name, prefixes generated ids with the island id and wraps the HTML in <ds-island data-c data-id data-p> with &, " and < escaped; revive's $slot (ds-slot, error when the slot has no HTML) and $el (lowercase tag or registered component, error otherwise) handling; renderStatic/renderToString prefixes; renderToStaticMarkup is renderToString. The client half of islands.ts (Slot's remount callback) and src/runtime/client.ts are not stated.
- New test src/runtime/server.test.tsx (9 tests) covering each statement, run in the islands vitest project (react aliased to preact/compat, as the pieces build does): vite.config.ts adds 'src/runtime/**/*.test.tsx' to that project's include.
- Verified: npx tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit, npx vitest run --project=islands src/runtime (9 passed), predictable sync (incremental). This PR changes no source code. The 28 violated requirements the sync reports are derived from analysis findings in other specs, none written by a person and none touched here.
- Shares no file with #15 (merged).

## How it was verified

Not verified by the analysis: no `predictable fix-check` in this session reported a defect gone for this change. Review it as an unverified change.
